outcome: Initialization is type-checked before it runs, with the same statement rules as the Controller and Metrics
owner_impact: Third release of #577 (one code grammar). Initialization now uses the same statement parser as the Controller and Metrics, and is checked before anything runs. Mistakes are reported even in branches or helper functions that a particular run would not reach: a misspelled name in the branch for another initialization method, a string where a number is needed, a name that changes type, or an if-condition that is not true/false. Before, such a mistake only surfaced when that code happened to execute. Nothing that worked changes: all 46 production Initializations (every current Experiment, working copy and revision) compile to exactly the same result with the new compiler, the 40 real Initialization programs in the test corpus are identical, and the simulator is untouched. GPT's contract is now vlab.authoring/0.12 and states these rules. Test now: optional. In an Initialization, introduce a typo in the branch of the method you are not using; the Lab now reports it immediately.

next.text: #577 release 4: roles replace set_agent_state (exact compositions declared by the experimenter), and robots stop receiving the Configuration's global values such as N. It has not started yet.

technical_evidence: Shared statement parser gains language options (bare return, call statements, identifier-only assignment targets); Initialization parses through it and a new static checker (types scalar/bool/string/none/config/rng/place/range; per-call-type helper instantiation; Controller-style definite assignment and bool conditions) runs before the unchanged evaluator.

Production compatibility (read-only): 46 of 46 stored Initializations (13 experiments, 1 working copy, 32 revisions; the run seed injected as the Lab does) give identical output with the old and new compilers; none newly rejected.

Equivalence: changed cases are invalid mutants whose error wording changed, or mutants with errors in code the old compiler never executed; a regression the harness found (call statements containing ==) was fixed before release. New initializer-types.test.mjs (4 tests). Contract vlab.authoring/0.12, MCP 3.21.0. 707 tests pass; smoke and authoring A/B identical.
